ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast profile; approximately 60% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels and 40% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity white fields covering the majority of the fluke lobes. A contiguous low-intensity dark region is localized at the central peduncle insertion point and extends along the perimeter of the trailing edge. Dark linear streaks and irregular mottling are distributed throughout the light fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 95-105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration pattern with low-amplitude pixel variations along the trailing edge; serrations become more pronounced and irregular toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a slight upward sweep at the extreme lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected at the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes, likely indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High density of dark, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the white surface of both lobes, particularly prominent in the inner-medial regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; small calcified clusters at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined dark 'V' shape at the peduncle insertion point contrasting against the white ventral lobes.
